newsitem.title: USA: Kellogg Co Q4 profit vs loss.
newsitem.headline: Kellogg Co Q4 profit vs loss.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Q4 1996 operating profit before charges $0.78 vs year-ago operating profit before charge $0.77.

Q4 1996 net income after non-recurring charges and other unusual items totaling $110.7 million, or $75.8 million and $0.36 a share after tax, primarily from ongoing worldwide streamlining initiatives and a contribution to the Kellogg Corporate Citizenship Fund, a charitable fund.
Q4 1995 net income after $369.0 million in non-recurring charges.
Kellogg said Q4 operating results consistent with earlier projections made by company.
(All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)

NOTE: Full-year 1996 results include $121.1 million charge for productivity and streamlining initiatives in the United States, Europe and international locations, a $15.0 million provision for the potential settlement of certain international litigation, and $35.0 million contribution to the Kellogg Corporate Citizenship Fund. Total non-recurring and unusual itesms were $171.1 million, or $120.1 million and $0.57 a share after tax.

Full-year 1995 results include non-recurring charges of $421.8 million or $271.3 million and $1.24 a share after tax. Charges include $348.0 million for productivity and operational streamlining initiatives in the United States, Europe and Australia and $73.8 million writedown of certain operating assets in North America and the Asia-Pacific region.
Excluding items, full-year 1996 operating profit was $3.07 a share vs $3.48 in 1995.
